regime_assessment.summary: Broad energy and industrial commodity spike as of Mar 6; oil/gas/refined products and polymers up sharply. Classification requires curve structure, inventories, export pace, cross-commodity confirmation and COT—not in snapshot.

notes: Snapshot shows large weekly/monthly moves consistent with either risk premium or real tightness.
Futures curve structure (backwardation vs contango) not provided—needed for variable 1.
Inventories / stocks-to-use trend not provided—needed for variable 2.
Export pace / shipment disruptions not in snapshot—variable 4.
Cross-commodity confirmation (e.g. soy oil vs soymeal, corn/ethanol) not in snapshot—variable 5.
Positioning / COT vs fundamentals not in snapshot—variable 6.
Until 6-variable checklist is filled, treat as transition; do not assume sustained real cycle.

beneficiaries.mechanism: Higher oil/gas prices support day-rates and utilization; upstream capex and activity demand.
invalidation: No sustained physical disruption in Middle East

beneficiaries.mechanism: Wider crack spreads and refining margins when crude and product prices rise; inventory gains possible.
Pass-through of higher gasoline/diesel into retail; margin depends on timing of cost vs selling price.
Higher gas/LPG prices can support revenue; cost pass-through and contract mix matter.
Freight index up; higher rates support revenue if volumes hold.
invalidation: Hormuz closure rerouting away from VN-relevant routes

beneficiaries.mechanism: Throughput-driven; higher freight can coincide with volume; revenue from volume and services.
confirm_triggers: Volume vs same period last year
invalidation: Rates collapse with no volume offset

beneficiaries.mechanism: Oil up → synthetic rubber cost up → potential substitution toward natural rubber; needs price confirmation.
Safe-haven bid and inventory revaluation; demand elasticity risk.

losers.mechanism: Polyethylene/PP/PVC up sharply; input cost rise without pass-through squeezes margin.
Higher resin/chemical inputs; margin pressure unless full pass-through.

mixed.why_mixed: Depend on input spreads (sulfur, NH3) and inventory timing; sulfur up sharply; DAP/spread vs inputs and pass-through matter.
what_to_check: DAP price and spread vs NH3+sulfur
